facts.label: official

facts.text: Under Section 10(13A) rules of the Income Tax Act, House Rent Allowance exemption for employees residing in metro cities is capped at a maximum of 50 percent of basic salary and dearness allowance.

script.title: Kiraya ya ghar khareedein: 20 saal ka poora hisaab

hooks: 30,000 kiraya ya 60,000 EMI: 20 saal baad kaun aage?
Down payment ka paisa ghar mein lagana sahi hai?
Kiraya dena paisa barbaad karna hai?
topic.summary: Renting against buying the same flat over 20 years: rent rises, EMI, down payment, maintenance, property tax, and what the saved difference becomes if it is kept aside. When buying wins, when renting wins, and the questions a family should ask before deciding.
